messages:
sam: @jen_support customer 'Acme Media' says March invoice shows ~12,000 embedding units but dashboard shows ~8,700. They used our rerank/pairwise flow, and claim truncation on some inputs. Can we triage?
jen_support: Thanks @sam — can you paste the sample request + invoice id?
sam: invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-998. Example payload they sent:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings:rerank
{
  "model": "open-rerank-1",
  "pairwise": true,
  "inputs": [["docA","query1"], ["docB","query1"], ...]
}
```
They said the client library did some client-side truncation and also retried when they saw `500`/`429`.
alex_billing: pulling ledger entries now. I see a cluster of ledger records labeled `async-replay`/`bulk-split` around 2026-03-15 that sum higher than dashboard. Some entries have `metadata.dimensions=0`.
sara_ml: two quick hypotheses: (1) pairwise accounting can double-count if padded pairs are counted per element instead of per pair, (2) truncation produced empty vectors (dim=0) which weren't excluded by metering, so replay dedupe didn't catch them. Need repro artifacts.
devon: repro plan: ask customer for the CSV manifest & original request IDs, then run our local replay tool with `--dry-run --preserve-ids` to compare what metering would have recorded.
replay-bot: Replay job queued by @devon at 2321112300 (job id r-87c3). Use flag `--keep-empty-vectors` to reproduce old invoice behavior.
jen_support: customer provided the CSV (link). Observed that client sent a large batch of ~256 that our splitter converted to 64/64/128 — splitter logs attached.
sam: our embedding logs show `embedding.dimensions=768` for most rows, but ~1,200 events where `embedding.dimensions=0` and `status=truncated`. Those 0-dim entries still show up in the ledger as full pairwise charges.
alex_billing: confirmed — ledger shows charges for those rows. Dashboard pipeline filters zero-dim vectors for UI display but metering pipeline didn't, so the invoice includes them. That's likely the mismatch.
sara_ml: interesting. That implies two independent code paths: UI pipeline drops zeros, billing pipeline counts them. We should either (a) make billing ignore zero-dim vectors, or (b) ensure truncation produces a consistent canonical representation (e.g., flagged but with original input_count) so dedupe works.
devon: short repro script (run in a dev env to emulate customer's flow):
```bash
python tools/replay.py --manifest customer.csv --simulate-split --preserve-original-batch --dry-run
# flags: --simulate-split will run our production splitting logic locally
```
jen_support: customer is ok with us running a replay in their account during low-traffic window. Scheduling for 2026-03-17 21:00 PST. I'll coordinate.
sam: note: customer also reported intermittent `500` errors and `429` spikes around the same timeframe — the routing fallback path retried to a cheaper variant, which may have triggered duplicate attempts. That could also explain extra ledger lines.
replay-bot: replay r-87c3 started at 2321112401; dry-run completed. Diff report attached: 312 extra ledger-eligible events when `--keep-empty-vectors` present.
alex_billing: based on diff, I can prepare a provisional credit for those 312 events and mark invoice as disputed pending eng fix. Drafting credit note now.
sara_ml: I'll file an issue in our tracker: `billing:ignore-zero-dim-vectors` and assign to eng-runtime. Putting repro artifacts and logs in the ticket.
eng-runtime: acknowledged. Initial glance: splitter may be attaching `origin_batch_id` inconsistently for truncated items; will instrument `split_batch()` and metering hooks to surface the original request_id.
devon: follow-ups for triage run: (1) eng-runtime to deploy an instrumentation build to prod in the next maintenance window, (2) billing to hold credits until verification, (3) support to notify customer after the 21:00 replay, (4) ML/infra to evaluate whether we should normalize truncation to `null` vectors before metering.
jen_support: I'll run the 21:00 replay and post results here. Customer contact: kate@acmemedia.com.
sam: thanks all — appreciate quick turnaround :thumbsup:
jen_support: next steps summarized: run replay with `--keep-empty-vectors --dry-run`, eng-runtime to triage splitter & attach request ids, billing to prep credit note, then sync post-run.
sam: I'll update the customer after we confirm numbers.
